# BuyGenix Solutions

> BuyGenix Solutions (buygenixsolutions.com) is an Indian B2B platform based in New Delhi. It connects Indian exporters and suppliers with live buyer requirements from importers and bulk buyers in India and abroad, helps overseas buyers source from verified Indian suppliers, and handles export registrations and compliance (IEC, GST, APEDA, Spices Board, FSSAI, RCMC and more).

Buyer contact details are shared only with paying members. Overseas and domestic buyers can post their requirements free.

## For exporters and suppliers
- [Buyers & importers by category](https://www.buygenixsolutions.com/buyers): live buyer requirements by category, sub-category and product
- [Export Demand Report](https://www.buygenixsolutions.com/export-demand-report): monthly ranking of the most requested export products and the most active import markets, from live buyer requirements (no counts published)
- [Buyers & importers by country](https://www.buygenixsolutions.com/buyers/countries): buyer requirements grouped by country (UAE, UK, USA, Australia, Singapore, Saudi Arabia, Germany and more)
- [Search buy leads](https://www.buygenixsolutions.com/buy-lead-search): search buyer requirements by product
- [Verified buyer leads for exporters](https://www.buygenixsolutions.com/export-buyer-leads): what a BuyGenix buyer lead is, how leads are shared (max 5 sellers each) and how exporters unlock buyer contacts
- [Membership plans](https://www.buygenixsolutions.com/membership): yearly plans with monthly buyer lead credits (Starter 5, Growth 10, Professional 15, Enterprise 30 a month), a Relationship Manager and business listing
- [Services](https://www.buygenixsolutions.com/services): buyer leads, digital catalogue, SEO and registrations
- [Export registrations](https://www.buygenixsolutions.com/registration): IEC, GST, APEDA, FSSAI, RCMC, Spices Board and other registrations

## Registration and compliance services (260+ services in 16 categories)
- [Basic Business Registrations](https://www.buygenixsolutions.com/basic-business-registrations): 20 services. Business registration help in India: PAN, TAN, Udyam (MSME), DSC, proprietorship, partnership, LLP and company incorporation, filed and followed up by one team.
- [GST Services](https://www.buygenixsolutions.com/gst-services): 20 services. GST services for exporters: GST registration, LUT filing for zero-rated exports, monthly and annual returns, amendments and IGST refunds, handled end to end.
- [DGFT & IEC Services](https://www.buygenixsolutions.com/dgft-iec-services): 20 services. IEC code registration, IEC update and DGFT services for exporters: applications, modifications and DGFT portal support, filed and tracked by one team.
- [RCMC & Export Promotion Councils](https://www.buygenixsolutions.com/rcmc-export-promotion-council): 15 services. RCMC registration and renewal with FIEO, EEPC and other export promotion councils: choosing the right council, application, documents and follow-up.
- [ICEGATE & Customs](https://www.buygenixsolutions.com/icegate-customs-services): 20 services. ICEGATE registration, AD code and port registration, shipping bill support and customs query replies for exporters, handled by one team.
- [Export Documentation](https://www.buygenixsolutions.com/export-documentation-services): 20 services. Export documentation services: commercial invoice, packing list, certificate of origin, bill of lading checks and letter of credit documents, prepared correctly.
- [FSSAI Services](https://www.buygenixsolutions.com/fssai-services): 7 services. FSSAI services for food businesses and exporters: basic registration, State and Central licence, modification, renewal and annual return filing.
- [Agri Export & Digital Platforms](https://www.buygenixsolutions.com/agri-export-digital-platforms): 13 services. APEDA RCMC, HortiNet, Tracenet and other agri-export platform registrations for exporters of fresh produce, grains and processed food.
- [Commodity Boards & Sector EPCs](https://www.buygenixsolutions.com/commodity-boards-sector-epcs): 15 services. Commodity board and sector council registrations for exporters: Spices Board, Tea Board, Coffee Board, MPEDA and product-specific export councils.
- [Export Incentive Schemes](https://www.buygenixsolutions.com/export-incentive-schemes): 12 services. Help claiming export incentives: RoDTEP, Duty Drawback, EPCG, Advance Authorisation and other schemes, from eligibility check to claim follow-up.
- [Market & Compliance Research](https://www.buygenixsolutions.com/market-compliance-research): 13 services. Export market and compliance research: destination import rules, product standards, labelling and certification requirements before you ship.
- [Legal Metrology & Labelling](https://www.buygenixsolutions.com/legal-metrology-labelling): 10 services. Legal Metrology registration for packers and importers, and packaging label compliance for products sold in India and abroad.
- [Banking & Payment Documentation](https://www.buygenixsolutions.com/banking-payment-documentation): 10 services. Export banking and payment documentation: AD bank paperwork, foreign remittance and FIRC, BRC and e-BRC follow-up, and export payment reconciliation.
- [AI-Powered Export Services](https://www.buygenixsolutions.com/ai-powered-export-services): 35 services. AI-assisted export services: buyer and market research, quotation and contract drafting, export document checks and buyer lead qualification.
- [International Filings & Registrations](https://www.buygenixsolutions.com/international-filings-registrations): 15 services. International filings for exporters: US FDA registration and Prior Notice, D-U-N-S, US LLC and EIN, UK company, UK and EU EORI, REX, GS1, halal, Amazon Global Selling and ECGC.
- [Monthly & Recurring Compliance](https://www.buygenixsolutions.com/monthly-recurring-compliance-support): 15 services. Monthly compliance support for exporters: GST filing, export documentation support, RCMC, licence, DSC and FSSAI expiry tracking, and DGFT notification monitoring.
